{{Otheruses|Living Force}}
{{Cleanup|sectioning}}
{{Quote|Healing a dead planet is one thing, Chodo Habat, and healing a Jedi severed from the Force is quite another.''"<br />"''With all due respect, I believe you are wrong. In healing a planet, it is a matter of connection. As plants feed animals, and animal populations thrive and grow, life connects and expands, the living web of the Force. I have walked in the growing restoration zones and felt the fullness of life, and perhaps that connection will help make you whole again. Perhaps you will find more than you think on the surface. You, me, my herd, helped to build that, the life of the planet. Though we describe the restoration as a process, we are, in truth, opening Telos to the Force. Thus, I believe I can help you. That perhaps through your work with the planet and my guidance, I might restore some part of the Force to you.''"<br />"''You speak well enough, Chodo Habat, but perhaps you see all this as your chance to exert your own hold over others.|Kreia and [[Chodo Habat]], speaking to the Jedi Exile about her [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wound in the Force]] and the [[Telosian Restoration Project]]|<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
[[File:LivingForce-TJP.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Living Force was the energy of all life.]]
The '''Living Force''' was one of two complementary aspects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;an all-encompassing and all-transcending energy field&mdash;present in and generated by all living beings, connecting all of life which fed into the [[Cosmic Force/Legends|Cosmic Force]] in [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref><ref name="Destiny">{{TCW|Destiny (The Clone Wars)}}</ref> Thus, the life created the Force, as the Force created life. [[Sentience/Legends|Sentience]]&mdash;consciousness and thought&mdash;could be added on to life.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> The existence of the living Force was accepted by a minority of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> until the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;whose teachings of the Force aspect<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> were passed on to<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> the [[new Jedi Order]]'s founder, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="NJO UF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>&mdash;a sentient mindful of the Living Force let go of their conscious self and relied on their instincts,<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> living in the present and feeling instead of thinking, thus becoming attuned to life around them and enacting the will of the Cosmic Force. Life was sustained by the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]], which served as the biological vector between living beings and the will of the Force, and the greater quantity of which allowed a lifeform to have a greater connection to the Force to the extent of actively using the energy as a [[Force power/Legends|power]].<ref name="TPM" /> The Living Force contained the duality of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides of the Force]], the latter of which tempted Force-users, who must reject it by being mindful of their emotions. Prior to Luke Skywalker's confrontation with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Obi-Wan Kenobi told Skywalker to bury his emotions, saying that they could be made to serve the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Skywalker nearly fell to the dark side upon being provoked by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], the Emperor's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], threatening to turn his beloved sister to the dark side. However, Skywalker retook control of his dark side emotions, and let go of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]&mdash;his life&mdash;thus saving his father from the dark side of the Force through his selfless, light side act and allowing the redeemed Vader to save him in turn. As a result, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were destroyed, thereby restoring balance to the Force.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Through the Living Force, several Jedi, such as Qui-Gon Jinn, Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Luke Skywalker, and the redeemed Vader, were able to retain their identities after death; becoming one with the Force whilst still capable of manifesting themselves as [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] to the living.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

[[File:Yoda-naturist.png|thumb|left|240px|The Jedi acted in harmony with the Living Force.]]
[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who,<ref name="BoS" /> as with [[Kreia]],<ref name="TSL" /> recognized that the Force was [[Poison/Legends|venom]], taught that a school of Force power referred to as focus or Body encompassed abilities that were drawn from the living Force. Such abilities emanated from the Force user's cells and affected the physical bodies of others. As such, by the law of the living Force, any [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] installed on the user hindered their ability to conjure the effects of the Body. Using the dark side corrupted one's spirit and ravaged the flesh,<ref name="BoS" /> slowly reducing the user to madness,<ref name="DarkEmpire5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref> though it was possible to take life from another to bolster oneself, as well as to [[Essence transfer|transfer]] one's consciousness to another<ref name="BoS" /> living body by dominating its soul.<ref name="DarkEmpire3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], [[convection]], and [[cryokinesis]] were abilities of the Body school of powers, as was [[Force drain/Legends|Force drain]]; the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] built by the Dark Lord [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was capable of ripping the life essence from an entire army. Conversely, [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]] was also an ability made possible by the living Force.<ref name="BoS" />

Kreia, an [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and former Sith Lord who understood the Force as poison, and that the Force's cosmic will treated sentients without care, reprimanded [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Teacher/Legends|student]], the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], for being distracted at the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] of [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|''Harbinger'']] and thus not being mindful of the present, allowing their [[Sith Triumvirate|enemies]] to gather while they wasted time. The Exile performed<ref name="TSL" /> rare deed by [[Sever Force|severing]] herself from the Force, triggering a mass die-off of her midi-chlorians to the extent of curbing one's Force powers though leaving enough so that she did not die. Despite her loss of midi-chlorians,<ref name="BoS" /> the Exile regained the ability to channel the power of the Force under Kreia's tutelage, and in turn, Exile trained her non&ndash;Force-sensitive followers&mdash;the [[Lost Jedi|true Jedi]]&mdash;to feel the echoes within the Force and grasp the ability to channel it.<ref name="TSL" />

While the Sith preferred the use of artificial [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]], which carried the essence of its master's will, natural [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] such as those found on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] helped attune the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to the Living Force.<ref name="BoS" /> As with Kreia, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] consciously sought the triumph of the will of individuals over that of the Force<ref name="BoS" /><ref name="TSL" />&mdash;whilst all users of the dark side did so at least subconsciously<ref name="DarkEmpire5" />&mdash;and found that the will of the Force could not possibly know or care about the welfare of intelligent life.<ref name="BoS" /><ref name="TSL" /> Referring to the Living Force as the [[anima]], Plagueis found that the midi-chlorians, which all had a single unified [[Pneuma|will]] in the Force, were influenced by the host's mental state. In particular, negative emotions such as the loss of hope affected midi-chlorians to the extent of killing parts of the host's physical body. Plagueis also found that by imposing one's individual sentient will upon the collective will of the midi-chlorians that served as the conduit of the cosmic will of the Force, one could manipulate life.<ref name="BoS" /> Through his findings, Plagueis could sustain a dying person's life, the basis of [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]], and instigated the fatherless birth of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;however, the catalyst behind the birth of Skywalker that Plagueis instigated was the will of the Force,<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> which had the boy be the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] who would restore balance<ref name="TPM" /> to the symbiotic relationship between the living and the cosmic Force<ref name="Destiny" /> by destroying the Sith.<ref name="ROTJ" />
